in_sanskrit.name: Nigam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Poet, Musician, Melody Maker
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nigam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Nigam means 'one who creates poetry or music'. It is derived from the root word 'Nigh' which means 'to create'. Nigam is a revered title given to great poets and musicians in Hindu culture.
